# apple_ci_xcode_versions (Data Source)

Lists Xcode versions available in Xcode Cloud, with their test devices and runtimes. Use the ID as `xcode_version_id` on `apple_ci_workflow` and the destination identifiers in its test actions.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "apple_ci_xcode_versions" "all" {}

output "versions" {
  value = data.apple_ci_xcode_versions.all.versions
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `limit` (Number) The most records to return, between 1 and 200, after filtering and sorting.
- `name_pattern` (String) Return only records whose `name` matches this regular expression, matched as a substring unless anchored.
- `sort_by` (String) The attribute to sort by: `name`, `version`. Unset keeps Apple's order. `version` compares numerically, so `16.10` sorts after `16.2`: with `sort_order = "desc"` and `limit = 1` it returns the newest version.
- `sort_order` (String) `asc` (the default) or `desc`. Has no effect without `sort_by`.

### Read-Only

- `filtered_count` (Number) How many records are returned, after filtering and the limit.
- `total_count` (Number) How many records Apple returned, before filtering.
- `versions` (Attributes List) The records that match, in the order asked for. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--versions))

<a id="nestedatt--versions"></a>
### Nested Schema for `versions`

Read-Only:

- `id` (String) Apple's ID for the record, which `apple_ci_workflow` takes as a relationship.
- `name` (String) The version's display name, as Xcode Cloud lists it.
- `test_destinations` (Attributes List) The devices this Xcode version can run tests on, with the runtimes each supports. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--versions--test_destinations))
- `version` (String) The version number alone, without the name. `sort_by = "version"` orders by it numerically.

<a id="nestedatt--versions--test_destinations"></a>
### Nested Schema for `versions.test_destinations`

Read-Only:

- `available_runtimes` (Attributes List) The runtimes this device can run tests on. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--versions--test_destinations--available_runtimes))
- `device_type_identifier` (String) The identifier `apple_ci_workflow` takes as a test destination's `device_type_identifier`.
- `device_type_name` (String) The device's display name, as Xcode Cloud lists it.
- `kind` (String) Where the tests run: `SIMULATOR` or `MAC`.

<a id="nestedatt--versions--test_destinations--available_runtimes"></a>
### Nested Schema for `versions.test_destinations.available_runtimes`

Read-Only:

- `runtime_identifier` (String) The identifier `apple_ci_workflow` takes as a test destination's `runtime_identifier`.
- `runtime_name` (String) The runtime's display name, as Xcode Cloud lists it.
